diagnosis.root_cause: Single-threaded Q21 finalize creates per-order heap-allocated unordered_map/unordered_set (3 hash sets per order × ~300K+ orders = millions of allocations). TPC-H orders have 1-7 lineitems, so hash set overhead dominates actual work.
diagnosis.memory_footprint: Per order: 3 unordered_sets × ~200B overhead + unordered_map entry = ~700B alloc/dealloc per order × ~300K orders = ~200MB churn

edit_summary: Parallelized Q21 finalize with OpenMP + replaced per-order heap-allocated hash sets with stack-allocated arrays and linear scan (optimal for TPC-H's 1-7 lineitems/order).
expected_improvement: ~90% Q21_finalize reduction (~1000ms → ~30ms) via 64-thread parallelism + zero-alloc inner loop, yielding ~35% batch total improvement
